changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Other:Data Reconstruction' as it's redundant with text reconstruction, removed model implementation details (M_att, M_sha) and kept only the actual model names. Added Mistral and Qwen2.5 which were mentioned in the ablation experiments.
Normalized metric name capitalization to be consistent. All metrics mentioned are used to evaluate the quality of reconstructed text outputs.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The models mentioned are used for generation/attack purposes, not for evaluation.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on privacy attacks (Activation Inversion Attack) in decentralized training settings. The NLG aspect comes from reconstructing training data/text from model activations. The paper extensively uses automatic metrics to evaluate the quality of reconstructed text. No human or LLM-based evaluations were performed.
